author: felicepantaleo
body:
With a selection preset and `keepStableSpectators = True`, the logical graph kept only the status-1 GEN particles outside the selection. A pi0 outside the selection was dropped, and its two photons became separate GEN roots on the `UnderlyingEvent` vertex. So `reconstructableFinalState` counted two photons where the graph without a preset counts one pi0, and the level depended on the preset.

Now the selection also keeps every GEN particle of a `reconstructablePdgIds` species outside the selection, with its decay products below it, on the `UnderlyingEvent` vertex. The pi0 members of `reconstructableFinalState` are then the same with and without a preset. The fix adds no parameter. It uses `reconstructablePdgIds`, the list that the pileup GEN collapse also uses. A graph without a preset does not change.

The hitless-subgraph pruning (`dropHitlessSimSubgraphs`) now keeps the decay products of a GEN particle of a `reconstructablePdgIds` species, with or without hits. A pi0 therefore keeps both photons. The reconstruction can resolve or merge the two photons, and the adaptive association decides which one it did. Before, the pruning removed a photon that left no hit, and the pi0 was left with one photon or none. This applies with and without a preset.

The pruning also removes a status-2 GEN particle whose decay products it removed, and so on up the chain. Before, such a particle stayed as a GEN leaf without hits: for example a K0 whose K_S left no hit. It was a `reconstructableFinalState` member without a preset, and a preset dropped it, so the level depended on the preset. A status-2 particle that keeps a product, such as a tau with its GEN neutrino, stays.

A new unit test checks that a spectator pi0 is one `reconstructableFinalState` member with and without a selection, and that `underlyingEvent` still ends at its photons. A third unit test checks that the pruning removes a K*0 to K0 to K_S chain without hits, and keeps a tau whose only kept product is its GEN neutrino. A second unit test checks that the pruning keeps a hitless photon of a pi0, and drops a hitless photon of another parent and the hitless subgraph below a kept photon.
title: TruthInfo: a selection preset keeps the spectator pi0
